title: Panelsmith
blurb: Make comic pages on your phone from your own photos: draw or pick panel layouts, add American, European and manga word bubbles, design sound effects, pose 3D mannequins and creatures as panel reference (with fisheye and tilt-shift lenses), and export print-ready PNG, JPEG or TIFF.
controls: Frames: tap edges to add points, tap corner badges to round, hold inside a panel to move it. Content: drag, double-tap to edit. 3D R: drag limbs to pose, Mod to reshape, Place to drop the view into a panel
